en: Scanning life forms....target not found
So until they do... bye bye!
Raene, I lost Dartol's Rod of Transformation.
Every bodies coming...
%s puts his club away and begins swinging wildly!
Let us barter, Rin'wosho. Show me what goods are available!
This better be important!
Guards!
Where is Elder Bladesing?
These three again?
You couldn't handle a lone night elf priestess?
Mighty fine weather we're having here, wouldn't you say?
A clear voice rises from within the stone...$B$BWhere is your Medallion of Station, little one?  You may not speak with a Duke without proof of title...

The tower's defenses are at their weakest right now. The patrollers, sentries, lookouts, and even Gallywix himself are all infected and highly vulnerable to your special abilities and attacks.$B$BI want to see you enter that tower and when you exit, I want to see you covered in the blood of your enemies, the head of Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix in your hands, and the last of that poison in your pack. Take what you recover to Shenthul. He'll know what to do... I hope.
%s will be armed in 3 seconds!
There's blueleaf tuber in this trench! It's like gold waiting to be mined I tell you!

So you have returned to help Kum'isha, $r? Do not worry, the pang that you feel in the pit of your stomach is merely your willpower collapsing.$B$BThankfully, you will not need willpower for this collection. I am certain that you will enjoy the trinkets I will have waiting for you upon your return with the item.
You have a treasure chest?  Let me see!  Alright, find Zando'zan in the Cleft of Shadow.  Look for the tunnel going down in The Drag to find it.
%s lets loose a triumphant shout.
RUN THEM THROUGH BROTHERS!
It is located in the Trade District citizen.  It is nearly straight on from the entrance of Stormwind.
You're an alchemist?  So am I.  Perhaps you can teach me what you know...
Spirits of the forest, you are needed! Make haste to the Charred Vale!
There we are, $n.  The Scroll is fixed!  Hooray!

Hello, young $c. Are you here to bring me a batch of peacebloom? We are collecting them to make potions and elixirs for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Though tragic that we are forced into this war, the results will be even more terrible if we do not prepare properly.$B$BThe Horde has tasked me with the collection of $2020w peacebloom, and so far we've managed to put together $2021w. If you have it within your ability, please gather up all that you can and return them to me here.
Say that is a nice looking outfit you got there.
Lumurk open this box easy!
Sorry, but you've reached the limit of what I can teach. If you want to learn more, go see Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He's pretty talented, so I hear.
Will someone please give my little kitten a good home?
Yes, I offer training. But it's not cheap.
Elder Windtotem is keeping company with the goblins of Ratchet on the coast of the Barrens.
I... I have failed, $n. The Lord of Bla... The Lord of Blackrock is too powerful. He consumed my energy with... with ease. I turn... I... kill me... you must... you must kill me.
An amazing discovery you have made. I would love an opportunity to look at all of the failed experiments.
You can find Aldwin Laughlin at the Stormwind Vistor's Center in the Trade District.
%s begins to make strange grunting noises. The Tear of the Moons drops to the ground and shatters.
Get out of here, Tobias, you're free!
Don't forget to get some Flame in a Bottle from the box here.  You're going to need it to destroy their command tent.
Lucan Cordell has a small shop on the canal by the Stockade. I am sure he will be able to teach you the art of enchanting.
Icy Scale Bracers.
I cannot, Vaelastrasz! Surely something can be done to heal you!

I thank you, $n. Your dedication to my plea gives rest to my lost wife's spirit, and for that I could never repay you enough.$B$BI cannot say that my hatred will ever cease for the quilboar, but it is satiated for now.$B$BNow I must begin to rebuild my life.
